This work includes the EPIC air quality fund which supports local actors in generating reliable long-term air pollution data to drive national level impacts in the places of the world especially where it's needed most..

At the Epic Clean Air Program, we believe that air pollution is solvable and requires effective policies.. Effective policies require a demand for change..
